content:
The Poco F1 was incredible – a flagship Snapdragon 845 chipset for around $300, depending on the region. We won’t be seeing that level of value-for-money again soon, but the Poco F9 Ultra is a good spiritual successor.
![Poco F9 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_001.jpg)
![Poco F9 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_002.jpg)
![Poco F9 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_003.jpg)
![Poco F9 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_004.jpg)
Poco F9 Ultra
With an MSRP of €900 for the base 12/256GB model, the F9 Ultra is already cheaper than most flagships with a Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset. However, Amazon’s Black Friday deal price is €760. The better option is the 16/512GB model – more RAM and double the storage for just €70 more (the MSRP for this model is €1,100).
The phone has an excellent premium build and an outstanding display – a 6.9” 1200p+ OLED panel, 185Hz LTPO, with 12-bit colors and Dolby Vision. Battery life is similarly impressive with an Active Use Score of 24:35h (the phone has an 8,050mAh battery). The fast 100W charging support means that the phone can go from dead to 32% in 15 minutes (a full charge takes 54 minutes). The dedicated subwoofer is the cherry on top of the excellent stereo speakers.
The Poco F9 Ultra is also equipped with a very capable 200MP main camera (1/1.56” sensor, f/1.7 lens with OIS), a standout 5x telephoto lens with a 50MP sensor (114mm OIS lens, 1/2.76” sensor) and a 50MP ultra-wide (102° lens which we wish had autofocus). Check out our review for a more in-depth look at the phone.
You might also want to consider last year’s Poco F8 Ultra. The base 12/256GB model is €600 – that is if there is any stock left by the time you read this. The phone has the same Snapdragon 8 Elite Gen 5 chipset and a very similar display (120Hz LTPO instead of 185Hz).
![Poco F8 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_005.jpg)
![Poco F8 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_006.jpg)
![Poco F8 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_007.jpg)
![Poco F8 Ultra](https://fdn.gsmarena.com/imgroot/news/26/11/deals-de-poco-f9-ultra/phone/-159/gsmarena_008.jpg)
Poco F8 Ultra
While it lacks a 200MP camera, its 50MP main has a larger 1/1.31” sensor. And it still has a very capable 50MP 5x/115mm periscope, plus a 50MP ultra-wide. The 6,500mAh battery achieved a respectable 18:52h Active Use Score, but it is smaller so it fell nearly six hours compared to the F9 Ultra. That one costs €160 more, though.
We may get a commission from qualifying sales.
